searchText: Prysm validators (128) have made it to the genesis state. There's total 405 genesis validators. 235 more to go! Up to 89% of validators... Saturday afternoon genesis! What are peoples thoughts on changing `GENESIS_DELAY` so we can start the net today instead of friday night/saturday morning? If anything I'd probably increase the delay so it happens next week. Otherwise EU/US get very little notice of the change. But also I think we need to run a test of genesis where the minimum validators is reached before minimum time. Both points make sense to me. We could achieve both by increasing the validator count at the same time. I'm not sure if that's too much complexity, though. The other option is that we all just agree to leave it unsupervised this weekend and not announce it until next week if it works or to silently restart if not. 🙂 That also works. My preference is for some action that moves the launch away from the weekend. Long term goal is to launch Eth2 without burning-out core devs. If the consensus is to let it happen on the weekend, then I can deal with that too. It's not mission-critical so I won't be asking any of our team to give up their Saturday at short notice. I'll still be around to watch over it though, I was partly responsible for the delayed start. Maybe one more genesis delay change to go to the standard T+2 finance model (+2 workdays). Public holidays are a real pain though. coordination problem. everyone but you aussies are asleep Won't it be Friday evening for US and very early Saturday morning for Europe? It's not mission-critical so I won't be asking any of our team to give up their Saturday at short notice. I'll still be around to watch over it though, I was partly responsible for the delayed start. That means we do have a chance to push back genesis if we want. So 48 + 72 delay would min GENESIS_DELAY=432000 by my calculations (but I'm not having a good week for unit conversions so you should double check that...). We should get the last few required validators any moment now I think. 432000 looks right ok, I think we have Lighthouse, Teku and Prysm ok with the change. If Afri and Nimbus are ok with it I think it's worth the change. Would be good to agree some bootnode ENRs at the same time so we can then have everything ready to kick off. <@557201004060213248> ☝️ for when you wake up. We can run a bootnode or two, will drop the ENR somewhere once we have it running hmm, I'm still only at 99% of validators required. And I *think* all the deposits should have been processed by now. Pushing back `MIN_GENESIS_TIME` would be perfectly fine for us > So likley genesis will be in the middle of night for afri again 😂 😭 I'm fine with having the genesis at night tomorrow. If you insist on delaying genesis, that is fine by me, _however_, I'll be offline for two weeks starting on Sunday. So for personal reasons, I would prefer to be able seeing the genesis But yeah, weekend sucks. I understand why you would want to move it. Instead of changing `GENESIS_DELAY` I would suggest setting a new `MIN_GENESIS_TIME` Unless something has changed since I was last at my computer it may not matter. We haven’t hit the required validator numbers so can just time the remaining required deposits to get genesis when we want. What's the reasoning for that? I was under the assumption that the delay happens between the deposits and the genesis time and the min genesis time is just an additional boundary min_genesis_time is a misnomer at this point. It is minimum eth1 block timestamp that will be considered for generating the genesis state. there is always an offset from the actual time that the first eth1 block satisfies the min_genesis_time and min deposits. With `GENESIS_DELAY` tuning, we can configure whatever time we want from that point Or we can push back `MIN_GENESIS_TIME` which would allow for potentially more deposits between now and then. Then once the time is hit, `GENESIS_DELAY` will still be applied Ok So we can set min_genesis_time to be on saturday, leave the delay the same, and have genesis on monday or we can work with the current min_genesis_time param (and when deposits were acutally hit) and add the offset to pick a very specific time How about min_genesis_time as saturday at 12:30pm UTC. That would put the actually genesis time (with a 48 hour offset) at monday 12:30pm UTC. A bit early for the US, good for europe, a bit late for australia (but not quite as late as the eth2 calls) Sounds good to me. excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
min_genesis_time is a misnomer at this point. It is minimum eth1 block timestamp that will be considered for generating the genesis state.

there is always an offset from the actual time that the first eth1 block satisfies the min_genesis_time and min deposits. This offset allows for (1) handling the follow distance safely and (2) allowing for manual intervention if needed

What we currently have (with the current min_genesis_time/min_deposits config) is some time ~9 hours ago. With `GENESIS_DELAY` tuning, we can configure whatever time we want from that point

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: Or we can push back `MIN_GENESIS_TIME` which would allow for potentially more deposits between now and then. Then once the time is hit, `GENESIS_DELAY` will still be applied

So we can set min_genesis_time to be on saturday, leave the delay the same, and have genesis on monday

or we can work with the current min_genesis_time param (and when deposits were acutally hit) and add the offset to pick a very specific time
